No unlike-unit totals. Only posted losses are analysed. Missing reports are not zero; unpriced loss stays visible. Existing loss-price snapshots stay unchanged after price updates. Processing loss is not deducted or added twice.

Every input is consumed once at the actual centre; only one output is created per batch. Shortage rolls back all rows; retries do not duplicate stock. Derived costs include all baseline inputs.

Dispatch reserves only. Acceptance moves the accepted quantity between the correct centres. Recipe definitions alone never appear as physical stock.

Blank remains missing; explicit zero is valid. All lines and named submitter required. Saved values persist. Retry does not duplicate submission or move stock.

Try self-approval. Have another authorised colleague approve; post a legitimate later movement, then post approved variance and retry.
Self-approval rejected. Approval alone does not move stock. Posting adjusts only the frozen difference once and preserves later movements. History and CSV retain source/cutoff.

Inspect cutoff warning. Attempt adjustment after a backdated entry; refresh snapshot and recount. Reconcile a transfer crossing cutoff and review without adjustment.
Unsafe adjustment blocked. Recount clears old physical inputs and keeps prior revision. Cross-cutoff transfers cannot create a duplicate loss correction.
Posted openings, receipts, transfers, production, waste and count adjustments
Open statement by centre/date/material/category. Reconcile totals, inspect source running balances and export. Include a material with over 100 movements.
Opening + additions ? removals + adjustments equals closing. Full history contributes. No mixed-unit quantity total. Exports preserve scope.
